headline.text: L2 moulding line down *1h 23min* on cooler jam with bent rails — cleared at 06:33, then a second jam at demolder cleared quickly.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran caramel all shift with no breaks. Three process issues flagged: dishwasher areas have allergen cross-contamination risk and weren't cleaned over the weekend, a box of bad-print product found from last week, and a Z conveyor being reinstalled after incorrect setup.
per_plant_summary.L2: Two mold jams on ML2. First jam in cooler at 05:10 required straightening rails 68-74, line back up at 06:33. Second jam at demolder at 06:58 cleared quickly. FFS had film loaded wrong way at 06:05, running again by 06:22. ML3 ran within spec all shift.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line ran all shift, weight checks on target. MF Matrix started on time but reported lost work tools. ML4 needs gondola cleaning and end-packaging setup completed today for tomorrow's CNC run. ML1 was cancelled for first shift.

notes.text: ML1 production cancelled for first shift on 07-27 per Rose Smuin at 16:04 on 07-26.

resolved.title: Mold jam in cooler, bent rails 68-74
resolved.summary: Cooler jam at 05:10 required maintenance to straighten rails 68-74 before line could restart, caused depositing stoppage on ML2.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:33 — "Line is back up. We have bars almost out of the cooler. Maintenance is going to dial in the line to 13mpm" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: FFS film loaded wrong way, missing rolls
resolved.summary: Film on VFFS was installed backwards and had missing rolls, required cutting and reloading.

resolved.title: Second mold jam at demolder
resolved.summary: Demolder jam at 06:58 on ML2, separate from earlier cooler jam.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:12 — "No is a jam at the demolder. We got cleared pretty quickly" (Alex Mendoza).

needs_attention.title: Dishwasher areas allergen cross-contamination and not cleaned
needs_attention.summary: Two wheat dishwasher areas and one nut allergen area — one wheat area has nut allergen items in it, no non-allergen area available for S4 items, and all areas dirty from weekend.
needs_attention.status: Katya flagged at 06:28 and requested follow-up with team; no resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: Z conveyor installed incorrectly on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Z conveyor needs to be disassembled and reinstalled correctly.
needs_attention.status: Justin reported at 06:48 that team is taking it apart and reinstalling; no completion confirmation by window close.

needs_attention.title: Box of HER Almonds with bad print left from last week
needs_attention.summary: Full box of off-spec product found on Sollich 2, indicates line clearance at end of week was incomplete.
needs_attention.status: Found at 06:46; Katya requested better line clearance process going forward, no further update.

needs_attention.title: Lost work tools on MF Matrix
needs_attention.summary: Work tools reported missing on MF Matrix line.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:49 via system message; no follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: Gondola cleaning and end-packaging setup needed for CNC run
needs_attention.summary: Gondola cleaning must be completed today for tomorrow's CNC run, plastic dust getting underneath needs solution; end packaging and TG machine setups also required for FEA CNC caddies.
needs_attention.status: Itzel requested solution from Nelson and Nathan at 06:55 for cleaning and setup work; no resolution by window close.
